selected_framework.name: custom Python + direct ADB + OpenCV + local OCR
selected_framework.role: private Unraid worker capture/transport, deterministic profile/state recognition, ROI-specific OCR, dry-run target resolution, and project-owned policy-gated action integration
selected_framework.scheduler_controller_scope: future SQLite scheduler/controller remains outside this selection task
selected_framework.m6_authorization_scope: final locked-runtime corpus capture/labeling and replay validation only; no gameplay input or Daily Quest authorization

methodology.corpus: retained MVP startup-normalization corpus; same Cash Mall, Ending Soon, Home/Base, keyguard/launcher, and profile-mismatch fixtures for every candidate
methodology.flow: observe/reconcile startup -> launch/observe Cash Mall -> classify allowlisted Ending Soon -> resolve only back arrow -> dry-run annotation -> bounded postcondition review
methodology.live_input_policy: no repeated live taps; only the already-passed MVP trial remains live evidence
methodology.early_rejection_rule: reject when packaging or central-policy integration cannot be demonstrated without material dependency/runtime mutation and no measured benefit is available

custom_python_direct_adb_opencv_ocr.gesture_resolution: 10 mocks; one authorized, nine repeat-denied; zero input
custom_python_direct_adb_opencv_ocr.reconnect: five safe mocks plus retained RT-021 direct-worker restart/reconnect
custom_python_direct_adb_opencv_ocr.live_input: one prior MVP supervised tap only; no input during M5 bake-off

Airtest.reason: absent module/CLI; broad dependency surface and direct simulated-input API required an unproven unprivileged packaging and policy adapter

MaaFramework.reason: absent native/package adapter; native/pipeline ecosystem required an unproven unprivileged packaging and policy boundary

packaging_implications.selected: retain existing Python/CV/OCR worker surface and RT-021 unprivileged/private ADB boundary
packaging_implications.airtest: would add pip dependencies and an adapter around direct simulated input; not installed or packaged
packaging_implications.maa: would add native artifacts/bindings/pipeline resources and a policy adapter; not installed or packaged

policy_and_failure_behavior.central_gate_owner: project controller/policy, not a third-party framework
policy_and_failure_behavior.selected_behavior: stale, profile-mismatch, unknown overlay, target overlap, repeated input, timeout, and unexpected successor fail closed as UNKNOWN/blocker
policy_and_failure_behavior.reconnect: reconnect and revalidate ADB/profile/state before any future authorized input; retained RT-021 is the transport proof

maintainability_and_fallback.assessment: custom stack has the lowest ownership/dependency complexity while already meeting the representative safety contract
known_limitations: replay timings are not live ADB timings
ROI-specific Tesseract OCR is slower than template classification
M6 must replace development/reference fixtures with final locked-runtime corpus assets
RT-021 host-network fallback remains an explicit deployment limitation
account identity guard remains a later RT-016A/M7 task
maintainability_and_fallback.fallback_trigger: reopen Airtest or MaaFramework only after a pinned unprivileged package, central policy adapter, identical-corpus replay pass, reconnect proof, and measurable benefit over the selected stack

live_state.adb: documented loopback NAS daemon idle; no attached device in read-only query
live_state.temporary_tunnels_or_listeners: none for RT-012/MVP/RT-021; unrelated host services untouched
